messages.subject: Rasch after 2PL model
parts:
Hi phil

I'm using MIRT package to conduct an exploratory factor analysis to explore the dimensionality of the index and check for factor loadings through a 2PL moddel, but I want to use Rasch model for the confirmatory analysis because my sample size is too small.

 so i'm wondering if it makes sense to explore the data with 2PL model then to confirm the structure with a rasch moddel?

Thanks a lot for your clarification.

Danya.

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: Rasch after 2PL model
parts:
I'm not quite sure I understand the reasoning for using Rasch models here. If the sample size is too small for a 2PL model then how would checking if the fit be better than a Rasch model make any sense? Anyway, yes I would say checking the veracity of a Rasch model this way is generally fine, and use a likelihood ratio/AIC statistics to compare them. Also, itemfit() may be useful here, but this is also limited as a function of sample size (it's harder to detect miss-fitting items with little information). 

Phil
